verification.name: Before/after component and end-to-end benchmarks.
verification.detail: Hot 40i 1/2/4/6/8-thread sweeps used identical 2- and 16-token inputs. Selected 6 threads: 0.035022917 to 0.039292924 tok/s (1.121930854x), dense projections 3.987194x and lm_head 1.7502x. Every candidate emitted token 11/logit 13.8495; final default smoke emitted token 11/logit 13.5247.

limitations: Top thread snapshots were sampled 30 seconds into each run and usually landed during serial MoE compute, so they demonstrate system state but do not represent peak dense-worker utilization. O06 owns sustained per-core/affinity measurement.
notes: Eight threads was only 0.34% faster than six over one 16-token run but 1.2% slower in the short screen. Six threads is retained as the robust default; O06 will compare sustained affinity/thermal behavior.

Component profiling measured attention at about 2.7 ms for the 2-token screen, so no attention optimization was retained. MoE remained approximately 49 seconds and is still the dominant CPU bottleneck.
